state_changes.description: The object highlighted with the pink contour has undergone a shape change between the two frames. In the later frame, the top left corner of the object appears to be compressed or bent inward compared to the earlier frame, where the contour is more regular and angular. This suggests a deformation, likely due to contact or pressure from the adjacent white object.

The object highlighted with the pink contour has shifted its position and orientation. In the later frame, it appears to have rotated slightly counterclockwise and moved upward, causing a change in its overall shape outline. The lower left corner is now less pronounced, and the object's alignment relative to the white and brown objects above it has changed. There is no visible material release, surface damage, or significant size or texture change.

The object highlighted with the pink contour has undergone a slight deformation. In the later frame, the lower left side of the object appears to be more compressed or indented compared to the earlier frame, indicating a change in shape. The overall outline is subtly altered, especially at the bottom left corner.

The object highlighted with the pink contour appears to have undergone a slight deformation. In the later frame, the upper edge of the object is more compressed or indented compared to the earlier frame, suggesting it has been pressed or squeezed from above. The overall shape is subtly altered, especially near the contact area with the object above.

The object highlighted with the pink contour has undergone a shape change. In the later frame, the lower left section of the object appears to be more compressed or bent inward compared to the earlier frame, where it was more outward and angular. This indicates a deformation, likely due to an applied force or pressure.

The object highlighted with the pink contour has changed shape between the two frames. In the second (later) frame, the top part of the object appears to be compressed or bent inward, especially where it is in contact with the brown rectangular block. The overall contour is less angular and more indented at the contact point, indicating deformation due to pressure from the block above.

The object highlighted with the pink contour appears to have undergone a slight deformation. In the later frame, the lower left section of the object is less protruded and the overall shape looks slightly compressed or shifted compared to the earlier frame. The contour is less angular and more compact, indicating a minor change in shape.
